entities.summary: The prime minister of Mongolia is the head of government of Mongolia. Under the Constitution of Mongolia, the State Great Khural appoints the Prime Minister upon the President’s submission of a candidate nominated by the parliamentary majority. The Prime Minister shall be dismissed if no fewer than one-fourth of the members of the State Great Khural formally submit a proposal for the Prime Minister’s dismissal and a majority of all members approve it, or if a resolution expressing confidence in the Prime Minister is not adopted.
